meta.title: Achraf & Molka - Wedding Invitation
meta.description: You are invited to the wedding of Achraf & Molka on Friday, October 30, 2026 at Tej Palace - Complexe Mariem, Sfax.

intro.bismillah: In the name of God, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
intro.verse: “Our Lord, bless us with spouses and offspring who will be the joy of our hearts, and make us models for the righteous.” (Qur'an 25:74)
intro.invitation: The family of Mr. Abderrazak Attia and the family of Mr. Abderrahman Hakim have the honor of inviting you to celebrate the wedding of their children
intro.dateSentence: God willing, on Friday, October 30, 2026 at 9:00 PM

wedding.title: The Wedding
wedding.mapNote: View the venue and directions on Google Maps.

blessing.heading: A prayer for the newlyweds
blessing.prayer: O Allah, unite their hearts, strengthen the bond between them, and fill their home with faith and tranquility.
blessing.message: May Allah grant you a blessed life, righteous children, and days spent helping one another in His worship.

closing.message: May your days too be filled with joy and celebration.
